title: VERDA Repair Hair Mask with Shea Butter, Keratin and Argan Oil, 250 mL
altText: VERDA Repair Hair Mask in a matte sage green jar with a white lid, 250 mL / 8.4 fl oz
bullets: Repairs 3 months of damage: a rinse-out hair mask for hair that needs some extra care between washes.
Made with shea butter, keratin and argan oil: a creamy formula built around three ingredients, with oat kernel extract and panthenol also in the mix.
Leave on for 5 to 10 minutes: apply to damp hair, leave 5–10 min, rinse. It fits easily into your usual wash routine.
Wide jar with screw lid: easy to scoop from in the shower, with 250 mL / 8.4 fl oz of mask inside.
For anyone who wants a simple repair step in their hair care routine. For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, rinse well with water.
description: VERDA Repair Hair Mask is a rinse-out hair mask made with shea butter, keratin and argan oil. Leave it on damp hair for 5 to 10 minutes to repair 3 months of damage. Work it through damp hair after washing, leave it for 5 to 10 minutes, then rinse. The formula also includes oat kernel extract and panthenol, and it comes in a wide sage green jar with a screw lid, so it's easy to scoop out in the shower. Each jar holds 250 mL / 8.4 fl oz. For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, rinse well with water. Ingredients: Aqua (Water), Cetearyl Alcohol, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Glycerin, Behentrimonium Chloride, Hydrolyzed Keratin, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Extract, Panthenol, Citric Acid, Sodium Benzoate, Parfum (Fragrance).
